request: Remove mismatched sword-to-guard transition; unify metal and give engraving physical relief using the existing texture-offset method.

geometry.method: Smooth local collar deformation into the same eight-sided blade section. Upper collar corner normals become the analytic steel face normals. Blade retains the same section for its first 2 cm.
geometry.unchanged: Lower ornate crossguard, grip contact, pommel, independent tassel and gameplay dimensions.

steel.nonmetal_regions: Original atlas metal mask preserves jade, black wrapping and red silk.
steel.root_uv: Upper collar and blade share x / 11 cm + 0.5, z / 120 cm; FBX handles V convention.
steel.scope: Legacy V2 blade only; current blade uses BladeV3/surface_recipe.json

relief.maps: Height, tangent normal, AO, roughness and muted albedo share one groove field.
relief.steps: 8 coarse + 2 refinement, maximum 8 source texels, shared UV and original screen gradients for all PBR samples.
relief.fade: Blade edge, distance 100-280 cm, grazing angle and coarse mip attenuation; skip search when faded.
relief.scope: Shallow surface relief, without changing blade silhouette or gameplay collision.

publication.material_references: Own unified steel materials, unchanged tassel WPO graph with new atlas textures, corresponding whirlwind copies.
publication.status_source: import_receipt.json and catalog_receipt.json describe actual asset save and publication status.

hilt_finish.name: bright copper
hilt_finish.scope: Guard, pommel ring and shared metal fittings; nonmetal jade, wrapping and silk retain their source colors
hilt_finish.normal: Existing Hilt_Normal.png unchanged during finish-only updates
